column3: Freeze the TG-presence staffing policy and census contract; define live, protected, eligible, rejected, and observed_at fields with fixture and mutation evidence.
Implement and test the read-only mesh-staffing and mesh-board available query over live windows, charters, and Ledger state; fail closed when inputs are unavailable.
Make mesh-dispatch consume eligible staffing candidates, exclude TG and protected work, preserve one-owner pacing, and retain retryable promises on delivery failure.
Verify ordered plans create stable task identities, expose only the current eligible step, and preserve blocked/retry states with mesh-promises parity.
Run the bounded staffing pilot, verify owner receipt, artifact, retry behavior, and mesh-promises parity, then publish the witness verdict or explicit block.
